prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t objectively declare one single “best” dentist — that depends on your needs and preferences — but I can help you find the right dentist in Pleasanton. A quick way to get a great checkup and cleaning is to look for practices with strong reviews, good hygiene and communication, and that accept your insurance.

If you’d like, I can pull a current shortlist of top-rated Pleasanton dentists. Before I do that, tell me:
- Do you have dental insurance (and which plan)?
- Do you want a family/general dentist, a cosmetic dentist, or someone who’s good with anxious patients?
- Any scheduling constraints (evenings/weekends) or accessibility needs?

If you want to decide on your own, here are practical tips and what to look for:

Criteria to use
- High average patient reviews (Google, Yelp, Healthgrades, Zocdoc).
- Clear new-patient process, transparent pricing, and insurance/financing info.
- Modern equipment (digital X‑rays, ultrasonic scalers) and good infection-control practices.
- A focus on preventive care and patient education.
- Comfortable environment and staff who communicate clearly.

Questions to ask when you call
- Do you accept my insurance? What will my co-pay be for an exam + cleaning?
- How long is the cleaning appointment? (30–60 minutes is common.)
- Do you provide digital X‑rays and oral cancer screening on new patients?
- Do you use ultrasonic scaling and polish for cleanings?
- Are you accepting new patients and how soon can I be seen?
- What is your policy for dental anxiety or sedation if I need it?

What a good checkup/cleaning visit should include
- Medical/dental history review and discussion of concerns
- Full mouth cleaning (scaling/polish) and periodontal assessment (gum probing)
- Necessary X‑rays or bitewings
- Oral cancer screening and exam of teeth/restorations
- A clear treatment plan and cost estimate if issues are found

If you want, I’ll find current top-rated dentists in Pleasanton and give a short list with phone numbers, addresses, and what other patients mention in reviews. Which insurance do you have, and do you prefer any particular day/time?
